create_Emulo3Processor: create an Emu3Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal tasks
process_Emulo3Processor_call: call the Emu3Processor to tokenize text and process images into input_ids and pixel_values
calculate_generate_size: calculate the token height and width for image generation from a ratio and image area
post_process_multimodal_output: post-process generated model outputs to decode text or image modality results
get_num_multimodal_tokens: compute the number of placeholder tokens needed for multimodal inputs with given image sizes
